name: pawgress
description: Pawgress lets dog trainers look up their training sessions and dogs, and draft session reports for review in Pawgress.

interface.longDescription:
Pawgress is a business management tool for independent dog trainers. Connect your Pawgress trainer account to write up training sessions in ChatGPT.

With Pawgress, ChatGPT can:
- Find your sessions by date, client first name or package, and see whether a session already has a report
- Look up the dog for a session: name, breed, sex and age, the behaviours you are working on with recent progress, and summaries of the three most recent reports
- Save a draft training report on a session

Drafts stay private to you until you review and publish them in Pawgress. ChatGPT cannot publish reports, message clients, or change or delete reports you wrote, and it never receives clients' contact details, payment information, forms, waivers, or dogs' health, medication or bite history. Requires a Pawgress trainer account.
defaultPrompt: Write up today's training session with Luna: she held a 30-second stay and her loose-leash walking improved.
Which of my sessions this week still need a training report?
Summarize Max's recent progress before my session with him tomorrow.
